items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: James Cagney was teaching on the third floor also. He was a dance teacher in the Billy Pierce Studio

ctx.x: I think it became the in place for looking for talent, as you said, George.

Yeah. Well, it had to be. George M. Cohan was coming there, I mean, really. See, and a lot of these people were interested in like James Cagney -- see, he was in the process of being discovered by the moving pictures, you see. Earl Carroll, he used to come in there. George White. See, it was very important people in theater.
Broadway was getting into its peak.
